notes.title: New release coming soon...
notes.notes:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41581623/b81607bb25d00492d972a9bac1ac8f1a2616d8f8.png
🎨 My new game, Mewseum: Masterpieces, is coming soon!
If you enjoyed Square Logic, you’ll probably love this new release! In Mewseum: Masterpieces, every puzzle you solve reveals a piece of a famous painting, reimagined in the charming feline universe.

The game will feature relaxing puzzles with easy and medium difficulty levels, perfect for anyone looking to have fun without pressure.

I’m working hard to bring a playable demo soon. Help support the game by adding it to your wishlist and following the game on Steam to stay updated on all news and the official launch.

Thank you, and see you soon! 🐾
Rodrigo Albuquerque

notes.title: NEW UPDATE! Spaceship movement
notes.notes:
Now, when selecting the card to move, the direction cursor will automatically appear around the ship. Then just click on the arrow with the direction you want!

Other adjustments made:

- Adjustments of some levels


Hope you enjoy it!
